title: JournalEntryBatchDataPagedResult
description: A single page of records along with the token used to request the following page.

continuation_token.description:
The token used to request the following page, or null when this is the last page. Pass it back
unmodified. A page can contain fewer records than requested, or none at all, and still return a
token, so use the presence of this token rather than the number of records to decide whether to
continue. A token is intended for continuing a traversal that is already in progress; it should
not be stored and reused later.

has_more.description: Whether a following page is available. Equivalent to checking whether the continuation_token field is present.

id.description: The unique identifier of the batch

date_added.description: The date and time the batch was added to the system, in UTC

JournalEntryBatchData.description: Represents a post to general ledger batch
